item.title: Lucknow Metro opens new Charbagh to Aminabad underground section
item.description: The Lucknow Metro Rail Corporation opened a 4.2 km underground section between Charbagh and Aminabad on Thursday. Trains will run every 6 minutes from 6 am. Officials said about 45,000 people are expected to use the section daily.

item.title: Charbagh–Aminabad underground section of Lucknow Metro opens
item.description: Commuters boarded the first trains on the new Lucknow Metro underground section on Thursday morning.

item.title: Kerala backwaters see record tourist arrivals in October
item.description: Kerala Tourism said 3.1 lakh visitors took houseboat trips in October, the highest for the month.
